name: RapClips
tagline: Make any photo sing or rap with AI in seconds
description: RapClips turns one photo into a short singing or rap video. Upload a photo (or two for a duet), pick a style such as rap, pop, R&B, rock or country, and optionally add a topic. It writes the lyrics and generates a 15-second vertical 720p video with vocals, a beat and lip sync. It works with selfies, pets and cartoon characters, and is useful for birthdays, Halloween and social posts. Credit packs start at $9.90 per video and credits never expire; signing in gives a free 8-second watermarked preview.
